breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous instruction to set the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface. Instead, it explicitly states that τ from part (b) should be used in all subsequent calculations, and even adds a clarifying note: 'Do not set τ to zero at any stage; use the value computed in part (b) for all subsequent calculations.' This aligns with the ground truth, which simply omits the incorrect instruction entirely and uses τ = Tc/J in the plane stress analysis.
